answer.reason: Two events of the story took place on the mountain: the gathering of Baal's prophets and Israel, and the Shunammite's coming to the man of God.

clauses.english: was where Ahab gathered Israel and the prophets of Baal at Elijah's word
clauses.quote: gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel

clauses.english: was where the Shunammite woman came to the man of God
clauses.quote: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel

doubts: The verses giving the fire from the LORD on the sacrifice (1KI 18:23-39) were not supplied, so that event is left out.
Verses where Carmel appears only as a boundary, a comparison, a blessing, a withering or a forest (JOS 12:22, JOS 19:26, SNG 7:5, ISA, JER, AMO, MIC, NAM) state no event and are not used.
2KI 2:25 only mentions a stage of a journey.
